Shri Manas Mani Verma - learned Government Advocate for  respondent/ State.
Heard on I.A. No. 29381 of 2024, which is an application under Section 430 of B.N.S.S. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.

entities.text:
Additional Sessions Judge, Lavkushnagar,
Distt. Chattarpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the appellant submits that appellant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in this case.

He submits that P.W.5 Dr. Bhavna Tripathi vide M.L.C. Ex. P/7 had advised X- ray of right elbow, knee, illiac crest and wrist but that was not conducted by P.W.6 Dr. S.P. Shakyawar,
who admitted that he had only seen the X- 2 CRA-10818-2024 ray of the left forearm and there was no fracture of left forearm.

Thus, in the light of the judgment passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Sunil Vs. State of Haryana, (2010) 1 SCC 742, it is submitted that when age determination is not proper, victim is hostile, P.W.4 School Teacher has categorically stated that there was no documentary evidence in regard to age of the victim and mother of the victim stated that at the time of the incident, age of the victim was 19 years,
there are good chances of success of the appeal.

entities.text: Sunil Vs. State of Haryana, (2010) 1 SCC 742
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He, therefore, prays for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.
Learned Government Advocate, in his turn, opposes the application for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to the appellant.

sentences.text: After hearing learned counsel for the parties and going through the record, without commenting on the merits of the case, we are of the considered opinion that this is a fit case to suspend the remaining jail sentence of the present appellant and to release him on bail.

Accordingly, I.A. No.
29381 of 2024 is allowed.

It is directed that on depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited and on furnishing a personal bond to the tune of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) with two solvent sureties in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Trial Court for his appearance before the Trial Court on 26.11.2025 and such other dates as may be fixed by the Trial Court, the execution of remaining part of jail sentence imposed upon appellant Langu @ Jaswant Yadav shall remain suspended and he 3 CRA-10818-2024 shall be released on bail till final disposal of the appeal.
C. C. as per rules.
 (VIVEK AGARWAL)
